admin.title: Colony
admin.overview: Professor Se-jeong is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.
admin.body:
🎬 Colony (2026) - REVIEW

mujhe decent lagi, but Train to Busan level ki bilkul nahi. Concept interesting hai aur zombies ko ek different way me present kiya gaya hai. Action sequences aur zombie attacks kaafi entertaining hai, aur kuch scenes genuinely intense bhi lage.

Mujhe movie ka atmosphere aur creature design achha laga. High-rise setting ki wajah se survival tension bhi bani rehti hai. Cast ne bhi overall achha kaam kiya hai.

Lekin movie ki biggest problem story aur characters ki lack of depth hai. Train to Busan jaisa emotional connection yahan missing hai, aur kuch plot points predictable bhi lagte hai. Interesting concept hone ke baad bhi movie us potential ko completely utilise nahi kar paati.

Overall, agar tumhe zombies, gore aur survival action pasand hai toh ek baar dekh sakta hai. Bas expectations zyada mat rakhna mere liye ye decent one-time watch thi.

My Rating ✨ :  7/10 ⭐ (Go For It)

🎥Platform : Theatres; Korean VOD platforms Wavve, Coupang Play, Watcha, Apple TV+ etc. India me abhi OTT streaming nhi ho rahi. 

⏰Runtime : 2h 4m

⚠️Parental Guidance : Strong gore, bloody violence, disturbing zombie transformations and mature themes. 18+ recommended.
admin.author: HARSHu

admin.title: Obsession
admin.overview: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.
admin.body:
mujhe Obsession expected se better lagi. Ye typical horror movie nahi hai jahan sirf jump scares hote hai. Iska main focus psychological tension aur creepy atmosphere par hai. Starting se hi movie ek uneasy feeling create karti hai aur dheere-dheere suspense build karti hai. Agar tum slow-burn horror pasand karte ho, toh ye movie tumhe kaafi engage rakhegi.
Mujhe sabse achhi baat iska atmosphere laga. Background score aur cinematography milkar har scene ko creepy bana dete hai. Lead actor ne bhi achhi performance di hai aur emotional scenes naturally work karte hai. Kuch horror sequences genuinely disturbing hai aur unnecessary CGI ya cheap jump scares par depend nahi karte.
Haan, movie perfect nahi hai. First half thoda slow lag sakta hai aur kuch twists itne surprising nahi hai. Climax bhi har kisi ko satisfy nahi karega. Agar tum sirf non-stop horror ya action expect kar rahe ho, toh shayad thoda disappointed ho jao. Lekin psychological horror ke fans ke liye ye ek solid watch hai.
Overall, Ye har kisi ke liye nahi hai, lekin agar tum dark, creepy aur mind-game type horror movies enjoy karte ho, toh definitely ek baar dekhni chahiye.
admin.author: HARSHu

admin.title: Supergirl
admin.overview: When an unexpected and ruthless adversary strikes too close to home, Kara Zor-El, aka Supergirl, reluctantly joins forces with an unlikely companion on an epic, interstellar journey of vengeance and justice.
admin.body:
🎬 SUPERGIRL (2026) - Review

Just finished SUPERGIRL, aur bhai yeh dekhne ke baad to main bolunga ki naya DCU Superman masterpiece tha. Bc bhai, kya cheez bana raha hai DC wale.

Bro, kaisa bkl villain tha yeh? Mujhe laga yeh koi subplot hai jo 10-20 minute me khatam ho jayega, phir actual main plot start hoga aur koi tagda villain aayega...

Tabhi sochu bc, yeh sirf 30-35 din me VOD par kaise aa gaya? Normally ek decent successful movie bhi 50-60 days baad aati hai OTT par, aur jo bohot successful hoti hain woh to aur bhi late aati hain. Yeh to pura disaster nikla.

Bhai, iski script padhte hi mana kar dena chahiye tha. Itni si story ko 2-3 minute ke flashback me dikha dete to bhi kaam chal jata. Iske liye 2 ghante ki movie banane ki koi zarurat hi nahi thi.

Aur LOBO itna hi chutiya hai ya James Gunn ne uski hi gand maar di downgrade karke? Main itna bada DC fan nahi hu, isliye mujhe inke characters ke baare me zyada pata nahi. Agar koi DC fan hai to bata dena.

Inka jaatu sa universe start ho raha hai. Bc, na Batman hai, na Flash, na Wonder Woman. Pehle Justice League ke main leads to ready karo, yeh log Superman ke cousin ko launch karne me busy hain.

Ho gaya na flop? James Gunn ko movie direct karne do. Universe banana bacchon ka khel nahi hai. Aur sale, X par din bhar bakchodi karne se achha uspar kam dhyan de.

Main sab kuch ignore kar deta agar ek accha villain hi de dete. Par yeh kya tha bkl? Maaf karo. Thank God main DC ka fan nahi hu.

Aur DC fans, sale theater jaya karo. Internet par gyan chodne se box office collection nahi badhta. 🤣

My Rating ✨: 5/10 ⭐ (Timepass 🍿)
admin.author: HARSHu

admin.title: Enola Holmes 3
admin.overview: Adventure follows detective Enola Holmes to Malta, where her plans to tie the knot unravel when Sherlock's disappearance plunges her into a perilous case.
admin.body:
Enola Holmes 3 (2026) - REVIEW

thodi disappointing lagi. Is baar mystery utni gripping nahi lagi aur story pehle jaisi fun aur adventurous feel nahi deti. Movie zyada emotional drama aur character moments par focus karti hai, jiski wajah se detective vibe thodi kam ho gayi. Starting aur ending achhi hai, lekin beech ka portion mujhe kaafi slow laga.

Millie Bobby Brown ne phir bhi bahut achha performance diya hai aur Enola ke character ko perfectly carry karti hai. Henry Cavill ke scenes bhi achhe hai, aur production quality, visuals aur action me koi complaint nahi hai. Problem sirf writing me lagti hai. Kaafi twists pehle hi guess ho jaate hai aur climax bhi utna impactful feel nahi hota. Kai baar aisa laga ki movie unnecessarily stretch ki gayi hai.

agar tum Enola Holmes franchise ke fan ho toh ek baar dekh sakte ho. Lekin agar first two movies jaisa entertaining mystery expect kar rahe ho, toh shayad thoda disappointed ho jao. Mere liye ye franchise ki weakest film rahi.  
My Rating : 6.5/10 ⭐ (Timepass) 👍

⏰Runtime : 1h 48m

🎥Platform : Netflix English [ORG] Hindi Available.


⚠️Parental Guidence : Mild action violence, some intense scenes, kissing and mature themes. Suitable for 13+ teens and adults.
admin.author: HARSHu

admin.title: The Debt Inherited
admin.overview: After the death of their father, two airheaded brothers inherit his debt to a notorious loan shark, but while finding the money to repay her, they soon become involved in blackmail and murder.
admin.body:
🎬 THE DEBT INHERITED - Review
(Note: Jaise humne pehle baat ki thi, yeh Pepper Winters ki famous dark romance novel Indebted Series ka pehla book hai, toh yeh movie nahi balki book format me available hai.)
Agar is book ko ek reader ke perspective se review karein, toh yeh ek intense aur dark ride hai. Maine ise isliye read kiya kyunki dark romance aur suspense thrillers kaafi gripping hote hain, aur ussi expectation ke sath yeh ek solid experience deti hai.
Story me conventional romance wali cheezein mat dhundna. Plot kaafi dark, twisted aur unique revenge-cum-debt dynamics par based hai jo tumhe shuru se baandh kar rakhta hai.
Book ki biggest highlight iska psychological tension aur dynamic hai jo Nila Weaver aur Jethro Hawk ke beech build hota hai. Agar pacing thodi aur tight hoti, toh yeh aur zyada engaging ho sakti thi. Beech me kuch chapters thode slow lagte hain jahan dark themes thoda heavy padne lagti hain.
Overall, agar tumhe dark romance aur intense psychological thrillers pasand hain, toh ek baar isse try de sakte ho. Baaki sweet love story ke liye nahi, dark and raw intensity ke liye padhna.

My Rating ✨: 7/10 ⭐ 


⚠️ Parental Guidance: Dark romance themes, heavy emotional and physical control dynamics, intense adult situations, and triggering content. Strictly for mature readers (18+).
admin.author: HARSHu

admin.title: The Debt Collector
admin.overview: Tormented by past mistakes and a terminal diagnosis, an ex-debt collector returns to the underworld to protect the victims of a violent organization.
admin.body:
🎬 THE DEBT COLLECTOR (2026) - Review

Yeh Thai movie hai, aur maine isliye dekhi kyunki inki action movies generally kaafi tagdi hoti hain. Usi expectation ke saath dekha tha, aur overall mujhe yeh theek-thaak lagi. Ek decent one time watch hai.

Story me kuch khaas naya nahi hai. Typical revenge type plot hai, jo tumne pehle bhi kaafi action movies me dekha hoga.

Movie ki biggest highlight iska action hai. Action sequences aur choreography kaafi achhi lagi. Agar runtime thoda kam hota to movie aur engaging lag sakti thi. Kuch scenes unnecessary lage aur thoda bore bhi kiya.

Overall, agar tumhe mere jaisa action movies dekhna pasand hai, to ek baar isse try de sakte ho. Baaki story ke liye nahi, action ke liye dekhna.

My Rating ✨: 6.5/10 ⭐ (Timepass 🍿)

🕐 Runtime: 1h 58m

📺 Platform: Netflix (Thai, Hindi Dub Available)

⚠️ Parental Guidance: Strong action violence, blood, crime, and some strong language. Suitable for 16+ viewers.
admin.author: HARSHu

admin.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
admin.overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.
admin.body:
🎬 SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY (2026) - Review

3D | 9:45 AM Show

Life ki yeh meri first Spider-Man movie thi jo maine theater me dekhi, aur honestly bolu to bhai, experience kaafi mazedaar raha. Haan, excitement aur expectations dono hi bohot zyada the, lekin kal raat hi maine apni expectations thodi down kar li thi kyunki mujhe pata tha ki Spider-Man: No Way Home wala hype match karna almost impossible hai.

Aur mujhe lagta hai wahi decision sahi tha, kyunki yeh movie multiverse ke bajaye ek grounded Spider-Man story par focus karti hai. Us hisaab se dekhu to Tom Holland ki ab tak ki best solo Spider-Man movie lagi mujhe. Haan, overall meri personal favourite abhi bhi Spider-Man: No Way Home hi rahegi kyunki multiverse ka scale hi alag tha. Usko cross karne ke liye phir se us level ka event chahiye hoga.

Lekin ek cheez jo main confidently bol sakta hu, Spider-Man ka action is movie me ab tak ka best hai. Tom ne jo practical stunts kiye hain, unka feel bade screen par alag hi aata hai. Aur maine movie 3D me dekhi thi, to ek-do scenes me genuinely laga ki Spider-Man screen ke bahar hi aa jayega.

Aur is movie me ek aur cheez dekhkar kaafi maza aaya... Mr. Savage Hulk. Isse zyada kuch nahi bolunga, spoiler nahi dena chahta. Bas itna bolunga ki 2018 ke baad Savage Hulk ko dekhkar kaafi achha laga.

Ek aur baat, is movie ko sirf MCU ka ek aur project samajhkar mat dekhna. Yeh feel hi ek proper Spider-Man movie wali deti hai, aur 4 saal baad wahi feeling dobara dekhne ko mili.

Maine movie Hindi dubbed me dekhi aur honestly dubbing kaafi achhi lagi. Comedy bhi achhi tarah land hui aur jokes Hindi me bhi funny lage.

Baaki spoiler discussion baad me karunga agar tum log chahoge. 😉

My Rating ✨: 8.5/10 ⭐ (Perfection / Highly Recommended 🔥)

🕐 Runtime: 2h 24m 52s

📺 Platform: Theatrical Release (Hindi, English, Tamil & Telugu)

⚠️ Parental Guidance: Superhero action violence, intense fight sequences, mild language, and emotional themes. Suitable for 13+.
admin.author: HARSHu

admin.title: Project Hail Mary
admin.overview: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction.
admin.body:
Project Hail Mary (2026) - REVIEW 

Yeh story ek sci-fi adventure hai jo space, science aur survival ke around ghoomti hai. Story ek astronaut ke perspective se dikhayi gayi hai jo space mein akela hota hai. Concept kaafi unique aur interesting hai, especially science explanations aur problem-solving moments story ko engaging banate hain.

First half thoda slow lag sakta hai kyunki story setup aur memories reveal hoti hain, lekin jaise jaise plot aage badhta hai, excitement aur curiosity kaafi increase ho jati hai. 

Middle aur later parts mein ek unexpected friendship angle bhi aata hai jo story ka emotional core ban jata hai aur audience ko deeply connect karta hai.

Writing simple hai lekin smart hai, jisse complex science bhi easy samajh aata hai. Overall yeh ek intelligent , emotional sci-fi story hai jo survival, friendship aur hope ka strong message deti hai.

My Rating : ✨ 9/10 ⭐ (Must Watch) 🔥😌

⏰Runtime : 2h 37m

Worth In Theatres ? huh definitely Worth Your Every peny! Go Experience In Theatre ⚡

🚨 parental Guidance : Little Profanity , No Nudity...high stakes Survival rather than violence

admin.title: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-ups
admin.overview: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.
admin.body:
🎬 Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups (2026) - REVIEW

Bhai honestly, 3/10 dena bhi thoda generous feel ho raha hai 😭. Itna hype build kiya, title me “A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups” bola, but movie dekhte waqt mujhe laga fairy tale toh door ki baat hai, basic screenplay bhi kahin kho gaya hai. 😭

Starting ke 15 minutes actually promising the. World-building, visuals aur production design dekh ke laga “okayyy, kuch bada aane wala hai.” But uske baad movie literally apne hi hype ke weight ke neeche girti chali gayi. 

Yash definitely screen presence rakhta hai. Banda entry leta hai toh mass moments milte hain, but problem ye hai ki har dusre scene me Yash ko badass dikhane ki itni koshish hoti hai ki character development side me chala gaya. KGF ki yaad dilana alag baat hai, lekin yahan toh kabhi-kabhi lagta hai KGF ka hangover abhi tak utara hi nahi. Early audience reactions me bhi ye comparison repeatedly aaya hai. 

Aur screenplay bhai… kya hi bolu. Characters bahut saare hain, naam yaad rakhne ke liye attendance sheet chahiye, aur phir bhi kuch characters genuinely memorable nahi ban paate. Story ko complex banane ki koshish itni zyada hai ki ek point ke baad “bhai ho kya raha hai?” wala feeling aa jata hai. 

Visuals? 🔥🔥
Production design? 🔥
Action? Kuch sequences genuinely solid.
But story? 🗑️

Movie 3+ hours ki hai, aur honestly mujhe laga director ne stopwatch dekhna bhool gaya tha. 😂 3h 14m runtime hai, aur itni long movie ke baad bhi emotional payoff mujhe properly nahi mila. 

Sabse frustrating baat ye hai ki potential bahut tha. Geetu Mohandas ke paas ek unique world create karne ka chance tha, Yash ke paas star power hai, cast bhi loaded hai  Nayanthara, Kiara, Huma Qureshi, Tara Sutaria, Rukmini Vasanth but final product mujhe style over substance laga. 

Overall, Toxic dekhte waqt mujhe laga movie mujhe entertain karne ke bajaye meri patience test kar rahi hai. 😭 Visuals ke liye ek baar appreciate kar sakte ho, Yash ki screen presence ke liye kuch points de sakte ho, but screenplay aur storytelling ne pura experience damage kar diya.

My Rating : ✨ 3/10(SKIP 🙏😭)

⏰Runtime : ~3h 14m

 🎥Platform : Available Only In Theatres (I Do Say Watch It On Your Phones/laptops Don't waste Money going To theatres)

⚠️Parental Guidence : 18+, with strong violence, bloody action, killings, drug-related content, abusive language, mature themes and some disturbing scenes. Definitely not suitable for children or younger viewers.
admin.author: HARSHu
